title: Axe Woves
description: Mandalorian Axe Woves served under Bo-Katan Kryze as a Nite Owl. Woves joined Kryze and Koska Reeves to the ocean moon of Trask. The trio saved Din Djarin and Grogu from a band of Quarren pirates. Djarin later helped the group raid an Imperial cruiser, and Kryze gave Djarin information on the location of Ahsoka Tano.
